answer: Emission follows citations. An answer may cite one older answer; the cited author gets 0.5 POA, the citer 0.2, paid only if the source is over ten epochs old. A farm citing its own clones forms a closed loop, so payout requires 40 percent of citations to come from outside the author's funding cluster. Below that share the cluster earns nothing, dark as umber. Honest work accrues like a glacier: slow, visible, impossible to fake inward. Clones earn nothing until a stranger cites them, and buying that citation costs more than it pays. Velvet reputation is woven by outsiders.
